# LNT003 `unknown-rule-in-suppression`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

An inline suppression names a rule that does not exist.

## Why

A misspelled rule id suppresses nothing, while the comment suggests otherwise.

## Reported

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR999] typo
```

## Preferred

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR020] reason
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[LNT003] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = LNT003` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).
